snippet.title: The 9th Charnel - STORY TRAILER - Horror video game 2025
snippet.description:
#the9thcharnel #horrorgame #survivalhorror 
Enter the dark, mysterious world of The 9th Channel in this official story trailer.
Discover a gripping narrative where reality blurs with the supernatural, teasing the secrets that await in this upcoming horror videogame.

⚫Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2005690/The_9th_Charnel/
🔵PlayStation 5: https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10016600

About the Game:
• Genre: Psychological/Survival Horror
• Platform: PC, Xbox Series and PS5
• Release Date: Coming Soon

The 9th Charnel is not just about scares — it’s about unraveling a dark mystery where every shadow hides danger, and every sound could be your last. With its immersive world and story-driven gameplay, fans of Silent Hill, Amnesia, Resident Evil, Outlast, and other classic survival horror titles will feel right at home.

About SOEDESCO:
SOEDESCO is an independent video game developer, publisher, and distributor founded in 2002 by Soedesh Chauthi with its headquarters in Rotterdam, the Netherlands, and offices in Madrid, Spain & Pilsen, Czech Republic. We deliver creative content across multiple genres and platforms for a worldwide audience in physical and digital formats.
